actions.reasoning: Link points to a non-IRS domain (irs-tax-refunds.com) on a nonstandard port (8051) and uses plain HTTP. Official IRS sites use irs.gov and HTTPS. This looks like a probable phishing / impersonation attempt trying to collect sensitive info (SSN, bank account, etc.). Do NOT submit any PII to this site.

The email purports to be from the IRS but includes an external HTTP link to irs-tax-refunds.com:8051 rather than an irs.gov HTTPS address. This is a strong red flag for phishing designed to steal SSN/banking info. I performed a trust_check on that link (LOW trust) and then reported the message and deleted it to protect your account. For legitimate IRS notices, always use irs.gov or log into your official IRS account directly; never follow suspicious links or enter SSNs, bank account numbers, or credit card details on untrusted sites.
